beats.intent: The core problem is that CTM represents thought compactly, while super-resolution must produce a dense spatial field.
beats.claim: CTM's thought representation is compact; super-resolution needs a dense spatial field.

params.headline: Compact thought must produce dense spatial output
params.sub: CTM is small inside; super-resolution is spatial everywhere.

beats.narration: Start with the mismatch: CTM keeps its thought compact, but super-resolution asks for a value at every spatial location. The method has to bridge that gap.

beats.intent: ThinkSR addresses the mismatch by keeping a persistent dense carrier that a compact thought process can read and update.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.

params.headline: A dense carrier stays persistent while thought stays compact

beats.narration: The dense carrier is the part that persists, so spatial detail does not disappear when thought stays compact. The thought process reads it and writes it back.

beats.intent: The low-resolution input is encoded into a dense feature field, then windowed for the compact process to use.

params.headline: The input is encoded first, then divided into windows

beats.narration: The low-resolution input is encoded into dense features first, before windows are formed from that field. That keeps the spatial carrier explicit.

beats.intent: The end-to-end path sends encoded features through windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, and a decoder.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.

params.headline: The model passes windows through shared DQ-CTM ticks

beats.narration: The encoder feeds the windowed features, and the shared DQ-CTM ticks operate on those windows before decoding. The path is simple and repeated.

beats.intent: The reported average puts DQ-CTM-SR near CNN baselines, but below CATANet among recent lightweight transformer results.
beats.claim: Competitive with CNN baselines; behind recent lightweight transformers.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is competitive with CNNs but trails CATANet

beats.narration: The CNN baselines cluster around the same reported average, and DQ-CTM-SR sits in that range. CATANet is still higher in this table.
